notes.title: Space Adventures - the final frontier!
notes.content:
The atomic space age survival 60 Parsecs! returns with new and even more twisted adventures of exploring strange galaxies. The brave Astrocitizens will come face to face with monstrous horrors from unknown dimensions, run the greatest heist the universe has seen, speak some French and even raise an AI of their own. 

🇫🇷 Liberté, Égalité, Félinité -  Let out of the bag by the French government, the glorious Astrocats explore the cosmos stirring trouble in search of the one comfortable place to land and lie down for a nap. Do you have what it takes to assist? Merci in advance.

☠️ Who let the muttniks out? - A rogue pack of space dogs is on the prowl. Think you can fly with them and keep up? Think again, comrade silly human-person. This here is a real job. The greatest heist this galaxy has ever seen! Want in? Prove yourself first. Ready? Go... FETCH!

🛸 SF is for space family - It takes a capable captain and their trusty AI to birth new sentience. Can the two of you survive the perils of the cosmos and accidental parenthood, while raising a UFO from its infancy? You might want it to become a respectable spaceship, but what if it chooses to be a galactic menace? WHAT IF?! YOU'RE NOT MY FATHER, CAPTAIN DAD!

👾 The Horrors of Space - Have you ever experienced true horror? No, that time when your soup fought back does not count. Not by a long shot. Beware of the void, dear captain. The void where dark creatures lurk and no one can hear you scream. The horror, the horror!

Can you survive that and more? Launch into 60 Parsecs! and try for yourself! 
Let's go, Astrocitizens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30837263/15ea4b078a1d3dd5cd00c191304cc5f75cc07c9f.png[/img]

- 1 new gameplay stage/element
- 11 new Space events
- 5 new Space Monsters (10 new monster events & 5 new visuals)
- 3 new questlines (14 new endings)
- 4 new achievements
- 3 new music pieces and new SFX
+ Main menu art revamp
+ 2 updated ending visuals


*Due to the introduction of new design elements and other changes, old save games will become invalid after updating the game.

notes.title: 9 years of robots, top hats, soup and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32964518/4b73d23a3dde4a631015576d9e05796ca7030059.jpg[/img]

Phew! We are so glad that 2020 is over, and now we can dive into 2021 [b]celebrating 9 years of Robot Gentleman together with you ️🎉🤖🎩[/b]

We want to thank you from the bottom of our robotic hearts for being with us for so many years, for supporting us, for making an amazing community. [b]You are the reason why we want to create games for the rest of our lives. Thank you so much for that ❤️[/b]

Last months were pretty crazy, but we won't bore you with stories about how challenging was shifting our workflow to the virtual studio model or how much we miss seeing each other at Pyramida Hub. We will share these stories (maybe) next time. 

[b]We must admit that our hands are full as we're currently working on new content for both 60 Seconds! Reatomized and 60 Parsecs!.[/b] Yes, there will be more to discover and more to survive in your beloved radioactive adventures. Keep your eyes on us! 

There is also something completely new. Something as new as[b] a brand new game[/b] that's being under development right now...

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32964518/aa45e2d0552cceecf84973a42f8c9d027f682a0a.jpg[/img]

This new game is yet to be announced, but we can't wait for the moment when we will be sharing more details with you. [b]Stay tuned, 2021 is going to be exciting![/b]

Don't miss our special [b]anniversary discounts on 60 Seconds! Reatomized and 60 Parsecs![/b] - celebrating with soup and apocalypse is mandatory!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1012880/60_Seconds_Reatomized/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/646270/60_Parsecs/

Thank you so much again for being with us! 
Stay with us, stay awesome and may the soup be with you!

- Robot Gentleman Team

notes.title: Souprise, survivors! A remaster approaches! 60 Seconds! Reatomized! launches this July!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32964518/24dd36aaa09d7531356d1773b79ce73c29f729da.jpg[/img]

We’ve spent 4 years in an atomic shelter together. That is no small feat. But there’s even more wasteland adventures to be had, because 60 Seconds! has been remastered and is coming to Steam this July! 

But don’t wait, add it to your wishlist NOW!
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1012880/60_Seconds_Reatomized/! 

The Reatomized edition is bringing tons of fresh upgrades and additions straight out of the (soup) can!

[list]
[*] [b]4K resolution support[/b] - see the apocalypse clearer than ever before thanks to the remade graphics!

[*] [b]New sounds, art and unlockable visual content[/b], allowing you to add a little color to your fallout shelter!

[*] [b]Survival Challenges[/b] - new gameplay mode with unique, short storylines which will put your survival skills to the test!

[*] [b]The Metagame[/b] - an opportunity to escape the wasteland in form of a storyline spanning across multiple playthroughs! Think you can you get out  in style?

[*] [b]New relationship system[/b] - more stories and crazy interactions between the McDoodle family members!

[*] [b]Brand new achievements[/b] for you to unlock!
[/list]

We’ve also got an explosive souprise for you! Each and every owner of the original 60 Seconds! on Steam will get the Reatomized edition (also on Steam) [b]FOR FREE[/b]! Just make sure you have it in your library before the Reatomized edition releases later this month.

Stay tuned for more during the upcoming weeks and stay prepared for your Reatomized shelter adventures this July!

notes.title: Balance & Bugfix #2 and Happy Birthday NASA!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30837263/2c6470b9e50b00215ea5089c713673fa9465b916.jpg[/img]

Happy Birthday NASA from 60 parsecs away! That's right, NASA turns 60 this very month! Fellow astronauts from the Astrocitizen program wish their colleagues at NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration many exciting adventures and successful journeys across the universe! 

It may be party time on Earth (or whatever is left for it), but we have not forgotten about the Astrocitizen crew stuck at the edge of space. A fresh portion of balancing updates, bug fixes and other adjustments to the game are now available for you to enjoy in your space shuttle. Have fun!

Thanks again to everyone for helping the game by reporting issues, sharing some great feedback and otherwise supporting us! 

Remember you can always reach out to us with any problems you've encountered in 60 Parsecs!: either through the Steam forums or via the support@robotgentleman.com email.

Stay tuned for further transmissions!

notes.content:

[h1]Balance time![/h1]

As promised, we were looking into streamlining a few things to make 60 Parsecs! an even better experience - especially in regards to hunger control. The results are in!

This is the first of two balance passes that we decided to push for. The extensive list of changes for the first patch can be found below. The second balance patch will follow next week and just like this one will include balancing updates, bug fixes and other adjustments to make sure you may have the best time possible with 60 Parsecs!

Thank you very much to all those who reported their issues, shared their feedback and otherwise supported us as part of the 60 Parsecs! community!

Stay tuned for further transmissions!

+++ 23/09/2018 1.0.1.49 - Balance patch #1

- disabled crafting bug fix
- quest progression fixes
- text fixes
- visual layer fixes in survival
